parsed.post: Discarding 0.991225 (regression). Reverting to best 0.988310 (AR=64, LR=0.03). Final probe: adding WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 to regularize the wide model. WD=0.0 has been standard; small WD might reduce overfitting on val.
parsed.description: Final round: add small weight decay (0.01) to the best wide+LR0.03 config to regularize and potentially lower val_bpb further.
